method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Two rows, 367.00 + 630.00 = 997.00, which equals Form A's printed TOTAL (997.00) AND both filled cover line-1 cells (THIS 997.00, CUMULATIVE 997.00). The LAST REPORT column is blank because this is the filer's FIRST report of the 2018 cycle (period begins Jan 1, 2018), so the period and cumulative scopes coincide - recorded as cumulative per the addendum. Cover line 2 (the $50-or-less aggregate) is left entirely BLANK in all three columns, so there is no small-donor aggregate and no sub-$50 trap here.

expenditures.detail: Two rows, 250.00 + 747.00 = 997.00 = Form B's printed TOTAL 997.00 = cover line 3 THIS and CUMULATIVE (both 997.00, LAST blank - first report of the cycle, scopes coincide). Contributions in and expenditures out are equal at 997.00, which is why the filer's ending balance is a written nil.

gates.balance_chain: Closes. Contributions 997.00 - expenditures 997.00 = 0, and cover line 4 (balance at end of period) is written '-0-' in the CUMULATIVE column (a nil glyph = 0 per the zero-glyph ruling); the LAST and THIS balance cells are blank. No earlier filing by this filer in this cycle is in my chunk, so the cross-filing chain could not be run - the cover itself declares this the first report (period begins Jan 1, 2018) and its LAST REPORT column is blank throughout, which is consistent.

notes: Generation-2 county-branded cover (Washington County Code 1-7-1) with the four-line anchor grid and an In Kind? column on Form A; the In Kind column is left BLANK on both inked rows (a blank is NOT an N - recorded in_kind false with the blank noted). Chunk file says candidate 'Brock R Belnap', office 'Attorney'; the cover's handwritten name line reads 'Brock R Belnap' and the Office line reads 'County Attorney' - AGREE. Certified period Jan 1, 2018 to June 13, 2018; signature date June 13, 2018; clerk RECEIVED stamp JUN 13 2018. Form A row 1 is not a third-party donor at all: it is the filer's own carry-forward, written 'Balance forward from 2014 Campaign' with the word 'Campaign' spilling across the rule into the Mailing Address column (that spill carries no digits, so it is a name continuation, not an address). Candidate home street address, ZIP, home phone and business phone printed in the clear on the cover were discarded at read time.
